audience: trades and field service firms that quote, schedule and invoice in TheBusinessApp

useCases.title: Review jobs and their visits
useCases.text: List the jobs, filtered by status or staff member. Open a job for its schedule and access notes, and list its visits.

useCases.title: Review unanswered enquiries
useCases.text: List the enquiries filtered by status. Open one to read the customer's request.

useCases.title: Create a draft quote
useCases.text: Create a draft quote for a customer with its lines. The quote stays in the app until a person sends it.

useCases.title: Schedule a visit on a job
useCases.text: Add a visit to a job. Then update the status or time of the visit.
